**Status:** `STABILIZED` Full V1 implementation.

## Parse one native Q2D artifact

`load_q2d_rlgc()` parses SCGSim's public AEDT 2024.2 combined `CG, RL`
export directly. The carrier contains one exact header and one primary
Capacitance, Conductance, Inductance, and Resistance matrix block with source
labels, units, extraction frequency, and original order. SCNSim validates the
complete conductor map and records a content hash.

Parser provenance is bound to
`scgsim@3e70aa8b6effc400d29fcef889814073b567d68e` and
`src/scgsim/aedt/_matrix_export.py`. This identifies the public producer format;
SCNSim still owns its parser, validation, and failure contract.

The native CSV has no per-file direction field. Its exact Q2D header is
therefore not independent provenance evidence. Calling `load_q2d_rlgc()` is an
explicit assertion that the file follows the fixed producer profile
`aedt_q2d_xy_cross_section_positive_z`; SCNSim records that profile as
`caller_asserted` and maps it to line head-to-tail. The parser validates only
the strict native schema and never upgrades the assertion to solver-verified
provenance. `reference_conductor` supplies the public name of the omitted Q2D
reference group.

The loader does not import SCGSim, accept a normalized compatibility CSV,
reconstruct missing mutual terms, or interpolate frequency. It returns one
frozen general `RLGC`; `N=1` remains the 1-by-1 case of the same carrier.

## Classify legacy adoption {#legacy-adoption-matrix}

Historical source is provenance, not product authority. The initial audit is
bound to `superconducting-circuits-research-workbench@19c26e86`:

| Legacy surface | Public relative source | SCNSim treatment |
|---|---|---|
| one-shot Python-to-Julia process and canonical JSON mechanics | `core/python/runtime/superconducting_circuits_runtime/runtime.py` | reuse mechanics after renaming, schema review, and path hardening |
| C/K/G factorization, Schur solve, matched-Port algebra | `core/julia/SuperconductingCircuitsCore/src/analysis/linear_response.jl` | reuse the generic algorithm; revalidate against the current Contract |
| uncompressed Zarr V2 real/imag writer | `core/julia/SuperconductingCircuitsRunner/src/staging/zarr_writer.jl` | reuse the small format mechanics with SCNSim manifests and relative paths |
| progress JSONL | Workbench Runtime and Runner progress surfaces | reuse only as an internal generation-level protocol; expose neither a public toggle nor callbacks |
| logical Port role and load correction algorithms | Core/Runner Port realization surfaces | port algorithm reference only; implement the current selected-network/PTC contract |
| targeted roots, staged action graph, report workflow, App/polling | Workbench application and staged workflow surfaces | rewrite or exclude; none becomes a reachable fallback |
| private consumer models, targets, paths, artifacts, and evidence | outside the reusable public mechanics boundary | exclude completely |

Useful historical revisions include `af6a7b30` (progress), `3b41463e`
(independent Direct/HB grids), `e7a47bac` (Port roles), `a4c58e6c`
(fixed-candidate evaluation), and `19c26e86` (resolved override binding). These
hashes explain mechanics only; they do not transfer acceptance or consumers.

## Deliver executable behavior in slices

The public V1 documentation and integrated runtime are complete in the
Human-accepted dev1–dev6 scope. All 13 ordered QMD/IPYNB lesson pairs exercise
that implementation. Full V1 is `STABILIZED`; acceptance, stabilization, and
integration do not imply release.

Runtime implementation followed four independently reviewed and integrated
slices. Each development version identifies the implementation introduced by
that row; the current Full V1 acceptance covers their combined public
semantics.

| Runtime slice | Executable scope | Behavior postponed by this slice |
|---|---|---|
| `1.0.0.dev3` — Author and analyze, Lessons 1–5 | Pint and primitive R/L/C authoring; Plan sealing; one logical Port; authoring schematic and `run.explain()`; exact Julia preparation and process protocol; original one-Port/no-trace `solve_direct` S/Y/Z; loaded diagonal root; primitive multi-variable/multi-objective CMA-ES over `DiagonalRootSpec.frequency` and `.linewidth` on a supported retained View; typed Results, presentation, standalone Report HTML, receipt verification, and restart-safe Direct/root/optimization `resolve()` | Runtime behavior taught in Lessons 6–13; the one-Port/no-trace limit applies only to `solve_direct`, not to `optimize_direct` or the general View law |
| `1.0.0.dev4` — Reusable composition, Lessons 6–8 | Frozen custom Libraries, exact factory provenance, declaration-ordered Composite public parameters, complete Composite and mutual-coupling snapshots, identity/`AffineMap` fan-out, recursive primitive expansion, and same-project catalog reuse | RLGC/transmission lines, N-port/PTC/transform, compiled schematics, full explain tables, inventory, extrapolation authorization/evidence, expanded Direct quantities, Julia NFC parity, HB, and the Lessons 9–13 runtime behavior |
| `1.0.0.dev5` — Advanced native Direct, Lessons 9–11 | general RLGC and strict native Q2D ingestion, N-trace pi expansion, named/N-Port selected networks, PTC compensation, retained-coordinate transforms, compiled expanded-graph schematic, `inventory()`, immutable model-default/consumer-override bounds with request-local extrapolation evidence, every remaining documented Direct quantity family, and the full scalar selector catalog: diagonal-root and hybridized-pole frequency/linewidth, transfer-zero frequency, residue-normalized-coupling magnitude, and response-element magnitude/real/imag; `QuantitySum` remains `CostObjective`-only | Full V1 HB and Direct/HB comparison taught in Lessons 12–13; selector and override expansion reuses the `dev3` CMA replay, ledger, cache, winner, and retry semantics without changing CMA numerics |
| `1.0.0.dev6` — Full V1 HB, Lessons 12–13 | pump axes, named drives and cases, truncation and mixing, JosephsonCircuits realization, selected-network/PTC adaptation, per-case partial outcomes, HB quantities and presentation/evidence, and Direct/HB comparison on independently declared grids | None within the current public V1; any later feature requires a separately converged contract |

The `dev4` compiler introduced backend-neutral intrinsic C/K/G expansion.
Dev5 extended that same compiler and Port authority with RLGC, N-port
`B/R/M`, PTC/transform/retain, compiled schematics, inventory, extrapolation
evidence, and the expanded Direct catalog. Dev6 extended the same request,
selected-network, workspace, and receipt authorities with HB; no second Port,
topology, schema, optimizer, or workspace model remains reachable.

The `dev3` slice implements the exact
[identity schema bundle](../../src/scnsim/_schemas/identity-v1.schema.json),
replacement/versioned workspace contract, portable catalog/runtime provenance,
and [diagonal-root numerical procedure](diagonal-root-numerical-procedure.qmd).
Each later slice extends those same authorities rather than introducing a
parallel schema, workspace, or fallback runtime.

The final row has no postponed behavior inside the accepted Full V1 scope.
Explicit limitations such as HB optimization, implicit grid interpolation,
public numerical knobs, release delivery, and the SCQGate quantization handoff
remain outside it. Durable stabilization tests freeze only the accepted
behavior above.
